notes: fill_px is the sum of w*h over every draw_rect in one rendered frame, measured on the host via the mock PAL (tests/coup/test_render_budget.c).
The Saturn VDP1 draws 1 px per 28.6 MHz clock, so ~477000 px-clocks is the 60 fps ceiling (ST-013-R3 VDP1 manual, txt:1114-1115).
game_over measures exactly 71680 = 320*224, i.e. a single full-screen background polygon.
That same full-screen rect is half of the game screen's total fill. Phase 1a moves it to VDP2 NBG1, after which the game and game_over ceilings in test_render_budget.c must be ratcheted down.
The pre-facelift build already sits at only ~30-33% of the frame budget, confirming headroom for the lighting effects planned in Phase 3.

MEASURED CORRECTION to the design spec: examples/coup/saturn/coup_music_data.h (2.7 MB of ASCII hex) is included by NO translation unit - it is an orphan. Music plays from the CD-DA track (rebellion.wav), not from WRAM. The spec's assumption that ~700 KB of resident music forces CD streaming for backgrounds is therefore wrong.

With 541104 bytes of WRAM-H headroom and a 65536-byte reserve, THREE 128 KB backgrounds fit embedded. Four would need 524288 against 475568 available - short by about 49 KB. Phase 1a embeds one background comfortably.
